name: palari-orchestrator
description: Optional MCP-facing manifest for Palari Orchestrator CLI tools.

tools.name: palari_ticket_claim
tools.description: Claim a ticket with Palari lease/fencing metadata.

tools.name: palari_ticket_ready
tools.description: Move a claimed ticket to fresh-context review.

tools.name: palari_scope_check
tools.description: Check changed paths against a ticket's allowed and forbidden scope.

tools.name: palari_lint
tools.description: Validate ticket fields, reports, and acceptance gates.

tools.name: palari_accept
tools.description: Run the human or authorized-reviewer acceptance gate.
